definitions.explanation: Describes a person who is accepting of others, not easily offended, and generous in spirit. Literally 'heart is wide.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{心|こころ}が{広|ひろ}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{心|こころ}が{広|ひろ}くて、⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{怒|おこ}らない→怒る：00876_okoru⟧。
examples.english: My boss is generous and doesn't get angry even when I make mistakes.

examples.japanese: {心|こころ}が{広|ひろ}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{文句|もんく}→文句：03636_monku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}わない→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: A tolerant person doesn't complain about small things.

notes:
An idiomatic expression meaning broad-minded or generous. Literally '⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧ (heart) ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ (is) ⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧ (wide).' Functions as an i-adjective phrase modifying nouns or as a predicate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {心|こころ}が{広|ひろ}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a broad-minded person
- {心|こころ}が{広|ひろ}くて{優|やさ}しい: broad-minded and kind

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{心|こころ}が{狭|せま}い→心が狭い：25593_kokorogasemai⟧: narrow-minded, petty — the direct opposite
- ⟦{寛大|かんだい}→寛大：15278_kandai⟧な: generous, lenient — more formal; often used for official pardons or tolerance
- ⟦{器|うつわ}が{大|おお}きい→器が大きい：25704_utsuwagaookii⟧: big-hearted — similar meaning using a different metaphor (vessel/container)
